review_decision: EVP_PKEY_derive; Build/import peer and local DH keys as provider-backed EVP_PKEYs, call EVP_PKEY_derive_set_peer then EVP_PKEY_derive.
semantic_invariants: Preserve raw shared-secret bytes (not an implicit KDF), peer validation, leading-zero/padding semantics, output length and error handling.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_free / explicit ownership model; Replace low-level DH ownership with EVP_PKEY lifecycle. Treat this as part of the complete DH flow migration, not a mechanical rename.
semantic_invariants: Map every success/error exit; preserve transferred vs borrowed BIGNUM ownership, reference counts and clear-free of private material.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_keygen_init + EVP_PKEY_generate; Generate provider-backed DH/DHX keys with explicit group/parameter configuration.
semantic_invariants: Preserve p/g and DH-vs-DHX selection, validation, private/public generation and interoperability with existing peer encoding.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param; Read public/private values through OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_PUB_KEY / PRIV_KEY using EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param where actually required.
semantic_invariants: Returned BIGNUMs are owned copies; clear_free private values. Avoid exporting private material if the caller only needs a provider operation.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_name / EVP_PKEY_new; Create provider-backed DH key contexts and EVP_PKEYs; do not create a mutable low-level DH object.
semantic_invariants: Preserve provider/libctx/property selection and cleanup on partial initialization.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_fromdata; Import public/private DH parameters via OSSL_PARAM and EVP_PKEY_fromdata.
semantic_invariants: Preserve old ownership-transfer behavior, parameter completeness, public/private consistency and private BIGNUM cleansing.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_fromdata / DH parameter OSSL_PARAMs; Import p/q/g via EVP_PKEY_fromdata; use explicit parameter names and validate the selected DH/DHX type.
semantic_invariants: Preserve p/q/g presence (including intentionally absent q), group semantics, ownership and validation; never silently substitute a named group.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_get_size; Use EVP_PKEY_get_size for maximum shared-secret/output sizing, not EVP_PKEY_get_bits.
semantic_invariants: Confirm the target provider reports the same byte capacity for the actual imported/generated DH key.

review_decision: EC_GROUP_get_curve; Direct documented rename to EC_GROUP_get_curve.
semantic_invariants: Preserve p/a/b outputs, BN_CTX use, prime-field assumptions and return/error handling.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_free; eliminate EC_KEY ownership; Migrate with EC_KEY_new/getters/setters and EVP_PKEY_get1_EC_KEY callsites as one provider-key refactor.
semantic_invariants: 65 frees require a full ownership map; do not replace mechanically until each pointer's origin, aliasing and transfer/refcount are known.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_get_utf8_string_param(OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_GROUP_NAME) or provider operations; Replace internal EC_GROUP pointer access with named-curve/group parameters or high-level operations.
semantic_invariants: Preserve curve identity and avoid retaining/mutating provider-internal or cached low-level objects.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param only when export is required; Prefer provider operations; if scalar extraction is genuinely required, use OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_PRIV_KEY and treat the result as an owned secret copy.
semantic_invariants: Do not create new private-key export paths; clear_free copies and verify provider/FIPS export restrictions.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_get_octet_string_param(OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_PUB_KEY); Read the encoded public point through provider parameters; decode to EC_POINT only where arithmetic is required.
semantic_invariants: Preserve named curve, point format, point validation and borrowed-vs-owned lifetime; do not assume compressed/uncompressed equivalence.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_name + EVP_PKEY_fromdata/keygen; Replace low-level EC_KEY construction with provider-backed EVP_PKEY creation.
semantic_invariants: Preserve whether the object is initially empty or already carries group/key data; make every failure path free contexts and keys.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY keygen/fromdata with OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_GROUP_NAME; Use the exact named-curve identifier as a provider parameter; do not substitute by curve bit size.
semantic_invariants: Preserve NID-to-group mapping, curve availability and key-generation vs public-key-import behavior.

review_decision: OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_EC_ENCODING; Use provider EC encoding parameter (`named_curve` vs `explicit`) when constructing/importing the key.
semantic_invariants: Preserve named-vs-explicit parameter encoding in DER; verify DPP peer compatibility and encoded output.

review_decision: OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_EC_POINT_CONVERSION_FORMAT or explicit point encoding; Set provider point-conversion format or encode the public point explicitly; do not mutate a key returned by EVP_PKEY_get1_EC_KEY.
semantic_invariants: Preserve uncompressed point form currently selected before i2o_ECPublicKey; compare exact DPP wire bytes.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_fromdata with OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_GROUP_NAME; Construct a new immutable provider key with the selected group rather than mutating a low-level EC_KEY.
semantic_invariants: Preserve group/point compatibility and reject mismatched curve and public-point inputs.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_fromdata with OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_PUB_KEY; Import the public point as octets with its exact group and encoding using provider key management.
semantic_invariants: Preserve point validation, group association and public-only vs keypair selection.

review_decision: EC_POINT_get_affine_coordinates; Direct documented rename; this is still EC_POINT arithmetic, not an EVP_PKEY getter migration.
semantic_invariants: Preserve prime-field semantics, coordinate BIGNUM ownership, BN_CTX and point-at-infinity error behavior.

review_decision: EC_POINT_set_affine_coordinates; Direct documented rename.
semantic_invariants: Preserve coordinate range checks, point validation, prime-field assumption and error handling.

review_decision: EC_POINT_set_compressed_coordinates; Direct documented rename.
semantic_invariants: Preserve y-bit parity, compressed-point decoding, curve checks and failure behavior.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_eq; Use EVP_PKEY_eq for key equality; use EVP_PKEY_parameters_eq only if the callsite intended parameter equality.
semantic_invariants: Verify key type support and the distinction between key equality and parameter equality.

review_decision: Remove low-level accessor; use EVP_PKEY parameters/operations; No safe 1:1 provider-native replacement returning an EC_KEY pointer. Refactor each caller to parameter getters or high-level operations.
semantic_invariants: OpenSSL 3 provider keys may return a cached copy; never mutate it or assume changes propagate. Preserve read-only behavior.

review_decision: Remove low-level extraction; use EVP_PKEY parameters/operations; No safe 1:1 provider-native replacement returning a mutable EC_KEY. Replace callers by operations/parameters; use OSSL_ENCODER only for actual serialization.
semantic_invariants: 43 reference-counted extractions must be mapped to their EC_KEY_free sites. Preserve no accidental private-key export or stale cached-copy mutation.

review_decision: EVP_PKEY_fromdata / EVP_PKEY_todata; Replace legacy EC_KEY assignment with provider-backed parameter import; create a new immutable EVP_PKEY.
semantic_invariants: Preserve public/private components, group, encoding, ownership transfer and error behavior; do not retain a legacy key silently.
